title: solanum indicum var. lividum
intro: Solanum indicum var. lividum, commonly known as Wild Eggplant or Indian Eggplant, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Solanum indicum var. lividum include its ability to lower blood sugar levels, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity against certain pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include solasonine, solamargine, and solanine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
